repos_data.description: A powerful multi-database server implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide AI assistants with structured access to databases.

Self-hosted, open-source AI-empowered MCP gateway: turn any API, database or MCP server into custom connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot & Cursor — no code. Convert REST, SOAP, WSDL, GraphQL & SQL to MCP, with OAuth2, RBAC & audit log. 175+ pre-built adapters (Deutsche Bahn, weclapp, Etsy, DHL, Shopware…)

An MCP server (and a CLI) that lets an LLM query your databases in natural language through a business semantic layer — glossary, metric definitions, data dictionary, knowledge base, and example queries — grounded against your real schema.
